# Event reference

The backend pushes these events to the screen while work is in progress. On the desktop they arrive through Tauri's event system; in a browser the same names and payloads arrive over the `/api/events` Server-Sent Events stream. Each event is delivered only to the account it belongs to (see {doc}`/developer/events`).

| Event | Emitted from | Listened to in |
|---|---|---|
| `ai_horde_progress` | `src-tauri/src/providers/ai_horde.rs` | `src/lib/stores/sceneGeneration.ts` |
| `chat-stream` | `src-tauri/src/commands/chat/retry.rs`, `src-tauri/src/commands/chat/send.rs`, `src-tauri/src/commands/chat/streaming.rs` | `src/lib/services/ipc.ts` |
| `embedding_index_progress` | `src-tauri/src/commands/embeddings.rs` | `src/lib/components/SettingsContextSection.svelte` |
| `embedding_updated` | `src-tauri/src/commands/chat/pipeline.rs`, `src-tauri/src/commands/conversations.rs`, `src-tauri/src/commands/embeddings.rs` | `src/lib/components/SettingsContextSection.svelte` |
| `multi-char-response` | `src-tauri/src/commands/chat/streaming.rs` | `src/lib/stores/chatMultiChar.ts` |
| `npc_created` | `src-tauri/src/context/npc/pipeline.rs` | `src/lib/components/ContextNpcPanel.svelte`, `src/routes/+page.svelte` |
| `scene_state_changed` | `src-tauri/src/commands/chat/pipeline.rs` | `src/lib/components/SceneDisplay.svelte`, `src/routes/+page.svelte` |
| `tts-chunk` | `src-tauri/src/commands/chat/streaming.rs`, `src-tauri/src/commands/tts.rs` | `src/lib/services/ipc.ts`, `src/lib/stores/ttsPlayback.ts` |
| `tts-download-progress` | `src-tauri/src/tts/download.rs` | `src/lib/services/ipc.ts` |
| `tts-stream-end` | `src-tauri/src/commands/chat/streaming.rs`, `src-tauri/src/commands/tts.rs` | `src/lib/stores/ttsPlayback.ts` |
| `wangp_progress` | `src-tauri/src/providers/wangp.rs` | `src/lib/stores/sceneGeneration.ts` |
